results.label: a fresh account is not_adopted with a revision to write against
recording four honest yes answers is a fresh pass
the pass carries the APP window and an expiry, not an unbounded permission
the recorded answers come back as given, with no sentiment or score added
the revision returned by a write is the one the next write may use
a write from a superseded displayed revision is refused 409 and stores nothing
both versions are retained with server receipts, none deleted or rewritten
